mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserStat */ USER_STAT FROM TM_USERXM WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
SELECT /* getInquiryCategoryCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM TB_CODEXD WHERE COMM_CODE = 'INQR_CATG' AND COMD_CODE = #{inqrCatg} AND USEE_YSNO = 'Y'
SELECT /* getLatestSuspensionNumb */ SPND_NUMB FROM TH_USSPND WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY REGI_DATE DESC , SPND_NUMB DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT /* getOpenSuspensionInquiryCnt */ COUNT(1) FROM CT_INQURY WHERE USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND SPND_NUMB = #{spndNumb} AND INQR_CATG = 'SUSPENSION_APPEAL' AND INQR_STAT IN ('INQR_RECEIVED', 'INQR_REVIEWING')

SELECT /* getInquiryList */ I.INQR_NUMB , I.INQR_CATG , C.COMD_NAME AS INQR_CATG_NAME , I.INQR_TITL , I.INQR_STAT , S.COMD_NAME AS INQR_STAT_NAME , I.SPND_NUMB , I.REGI_DATE , I.ANSW_DATE , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CT_INQANS A WHERE A.INQR_NUMB = I.INQR_NUMB AND A.READ_YSNO = 'N') AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM CT_INQURY I LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD C ON C.COMM_CODE = 'INQR_CATG' AND C.COMD_CODE = I.INQR_CATG LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD S ON S.COMM_CODE = 'INQR_STAT' AND S.COMD_CODE = I.INQR_STAT WHERE I.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ORDER BY I.REGI_DATE DESC , I.INQR_NUMB DESC LIMIT #{startRow}, #{pageSize}

SELECT /* getInquiryDtl */ I.INQR_NUMB , I.INQR_CATG , C.COMD_NAME AS INQR_CATG_NAME , I.INQR_TITL , I.INQR_CNTN , I.INQR_STAT , S.COMD_NAME AS INQR_STAT_NAME , I.SPND_NUMB , I.REGI_DATE , I.ANSW_DATE FROM CT_INQURY I LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD C ON C.COMM_CODE = 'INQR_CATG' AND C.COMD_CODE = I.INQR_CATG LEFT JOIN TB_CODEXD S ON S.COMM_CODE = 'INQR_STAT' AND S.COMD_CODE = I.INQR_STAT WHERE I.INQR_NUMB = #{inqrNumb} AND I.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
SELECT /* getInquiryAnswerList */ ANSW_NUMB , ANSW_CNTN , READ_YSNO , REGI_DATE FROM CT_INQANS WHERE INQR_NUMB = #{inqrNumb} ORDER BY REGI_DATE , ANSW_NUMB
mapper.update: UPDATE /* uptInquiryAnswerRead */ CT_INQANS A JOIN CT_INQURY I ON I.INQR_NUMB = A.INQR_NUMB AND I.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} SET A.READ_YSNO = 'Y' , A.READ_DATE = COALESCE(A.READ_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE A.INQR_NUMB = #{inqrNumb} AND A.READ_YSNO = 'N'
